mapper.select: -- 로그인 아이디로 사용자 식별자를 조회한다. SELECT u.id FROM users u WHERE u.login_id = #{loginId} AND u.status_code = 'ACTIVE'
-- 관리자 기본정보 입력 대상 회원 존재 여부를 조회한다. SELECT count(1) FROM users u WHERE u.id = #{userId}

-- 사용자 기본정보를 조회한다. SELECT mp.user_id, mp.birth_year, mp.region_code, mp.has_income, mp.income_presence_code, mp.income_amount, mp.health_insurance_basis_code FROM member_profiles mp WHERE mp.user_id = #{userId}

-- 사용자 사업자 기본정보를 조회한다. SELECT bp.id AS business_profile_id, bp.business_registration_no, bp.business_name, bp.workplace_region_code, bp.opening_date, bp.ksic_code, bp.business_type_code, bp.company_stage_code, bp.annual_revenue, bp.annual_revenue_year, bp.has_policy_fund_usage, bp.has_guarantee_usage FROM business_profiles bp WHERE bp.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY bp.updated_at DESC, bp.created_at DESC, bp.id ASC LIMIT 1

-- 사용자 가족 기본정보 목록을 조회한다. SELECT fm.id AS family_member_id, fm.relation_type_code, fm.birth_year, fm.has_income, fm.income_presence_code, fm.income_amount FROM family_members fm WHERE fm.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY CASE fm.relation_type_code WHEN 'SPOUSE' THEN 1 WHEN 'CHILD' THEN 2 WHEN 'PARENT' THEN 3 ELSE 9 END ASC, fm.birth_year ASC NULLS LAST, fm.created_at ASC, fm.id ASC

-- 사용자 기본정보 서류 입력에 사용할 표준 필드 목록을 조회한다. SELECT sdf.id AS standard_field_id, sdf.document_type_code, sdf.field_key, sdf.field_label, sdf.field_type_code, sdf.scope_code, sdf.required_default, sdf.sort_order, sdf.help_text FROM standard_document_fields sdf WHERE sdf.is_selectable = true ORDER BY CASE sdf.document_type_code WHEN 'BUSINESS_REGISTRATION' THEN 1 WHEN 'VAT_TAX_BASE' THEN 2 WHEN 'TAX_EXEMPT_INCOME' THEN 3 WHEN 'INCOME_CERTIFICATE' THEN 4 WHEN 'NATIONAL_TAX_PAID' THEN 5 WHEN 'LOCAL_TAX_PAID' THEN 6 WHEN 'RESIDENT_REGISTRATION' THEN 7 WHEN 'FAMILY_RELATION' THEN 8 WHEN 'HEALTH_INSURANCE_PAYMENT' THEN 9 WHEN 'HEALTH_INSURANCE_QUALIFICATION' THEN 10 ELSE 99 END ASC, sdf.sort_order ASC, sdf.field_label ASC
-- 사용자 서류별 입력값 목록을 조회한다. SELECT mdiv.standard_field_id, mdiv.value_text, mdiv.value_number, mdiv.value_date, mdiv.value_boolean FROM member_document_input_values mdiv WHERE mdiv.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: -- 사용자 기본정보를 저장한다. INSERT INTO member_profiles ( user_id, birth_year, region_code, has_income, income_presence_code, income_amount, health_insurance_basis_code, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{birthYear}, #{regionCode}, #{hasIncome}, #{incomePresenceCode}, #{incomeAmount}, #{healthInsuranceBasisCode}, #{actorUserId}, #{actorUserId} ) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET birth_year = EXCLUDED.birth_year, region_code = EXCLUDED.region_code, has_income = EXCLUDED.has_income, income_presence_code = EXCLUDED.income_presence_code, income_amount = EXCLUDED.income_amount, health_insurance_basis_code = EXCLUDED.health_insurance_basis_code, updated_at = now(), updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by
mapper.select: -- 사용자 사업자 기본정보 식별자를 조회한다. SELECT bp.id FROM business_profiles bp WHERE bp.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY bp.updated_at DESC, bp.created_at DESC, bp.id ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: -- 사용자 사업자 기본정보를 등록한다. INSERT INTO business_profiles ( user_id, business_registration_no, business_name, workplace_region_code, opening_date, ksic_code, business_type_code, company_stage_code, annual_revenue, annual_revenue_year, has_policy_fund_usage, has_guarantee_usage, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{businessRegistrationNo}, #{businessName}, #{workplaceRegionCode}, #{openingDate}, #{ksicCode}, #{businessTypeCode}, #{companyStageCode}, #{annualRevenue}, #{annualRevenueYear}, #{hasPolicyFundUsage}, #{hasGuaranteeUsage}, #{actorUserId}, #{actorUserId} )
mapper.update: -- 사용자 사업자 기본정보를 수정한다. UPDATE business_profiles SET business_registration_no = #{businessRegistrationNo}, business_name = #{businessName}, workplace_region_code = #{workplaceRegionCode}, opening_date = #{openingDate}, ksic_code = #{ksicCode}, business_type_code = #{businessTypeCode}, company_stage_code = #{companyStageCode}, annual_revenue = #{annualRevenue}, annual_revenue_year = #{annualRevenueYear}, has_policy_fund_usage = #{hasPolicyFundUsage}, has_guarantee_usage = #{hasGuaranteeUsage}, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{actorUserId} WHERE id = #{businessProfileId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: -- 사용자 가족 기본정보를 등록한다. INSERT INTO family_members ( id, user_id, relation_type_code, birth_year, has_income, income_presence_code, income_amount, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{familyMemberId}, #{userId}, #{relationTypeCode}, #{birthYear}, #{hasIncome}, #{incomePresenceCode}, #{incomeAmount}, #{actorUserId}, #{actorUserId} )

-- 사용자 서류별 입력값을 등록한다. INSERT INTO member_document_input_values ( user_id, standard_field_id, value_text, value_number, value_date, value_boolean, submitted_by, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{standardFieldId}, #{valueText}, #{valueNumber}, #{valueDate}, #{valueBoolean}, #{actorUserId}, now(), now() )
